name: Phoebe Davenport

events.title: 1850 census
events.description: Phebe Pringle, 52, real estate $150, in John Pringle's household with eight children.

events.title: 1860 census
events.description: Phebe Pringle, 62, head, with Elizabeth 36 and Lydia 34.

bioAdditions: Giles & Franklin give Phoebe's birth as 4 May 1799, daughter of Thomas and Charity (Lamoreux) Davenport, and say she married John Pringle (H0155). Their nine children: Thomas (b. 1821), Dennison (b. 1830), Clara (m. Sam Shaffer; d. aged 94), Charity (b. 1832; m. 1855 Andrew Worthington), William, Betsy (d. unmarried), Lydia, Martha (m. ___ Weaver) and Stephen (S1). The censuses agree. In 1850 she was 52, in John's household with Thomas, Clarissa, Elizabeth, Lydia, William, Denison, Charity and Martha. In 1860 she was a 62-year-old widow keeping house with the unmarried Elizabeth (Betsy) and Lydia (S2). Her will was proved in 1867.

conflicts.foundValue: FS KP7J-PJ2 attaches 'Phebe Davenport' as a child of Samuel Pringle and Martha Lamoreaux
conflicts.assessment: FS is wrong. She was Samuel's daughter-in-law (wife of his probable son John), not his daughter. Her maiden name Davenport and Giles & Franklin both show this.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Family genealogy matched by the 1850 and 1860 censuses (names and ages of the children).
